text_block_list.text:
One day, at Tazuna-san's request,
I went to deliver some handouts to Agnes Tachyon
on my way back to the Trainer's office.
choice_data_list: So this is her research lab...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
…………
*grumbleeee*...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon~!
Tachyon, come on! Wake uuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah! What, do you need Tachyon for something too?
Too bad for you. As you can see, she's occupied.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheh! Now, now, don't fight...
I'll turn the whole student body into guinea pigs, so line up nicely... Hehehe! Mmmnya...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Jeez, I went out of my way to come hang out with you, and now it's just boring!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What could this be?
The computer screen was left on...
choice_data_list: I wonder what this is... a report?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it! This is a medicine recipe.
Whoa... an agent to promote bone cell repair!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because that's what it says, isn't it?
You'll see if you read it, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, this looks pretty interesting...!
It's just like a magic potion I saw in a spellbook before.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know!
I'll whip up this medicine while Tachyon's asleep♪
Should be a great way to kill time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Bleh! It's your fault for sleeping!
If you don't like it, just wake up~!
Feeling worried, I decided to keep an eye on her, but Sweep Tosho briskly went about concocting the medicine...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hum-de-hum~~♪
Now to crank up the heat all at once...!
(――POOF!!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Quiet down, familiar.
Didn't the text say this would happen along the way~?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, that's proof of success! Look, the color's starting to change♪
Just simmer it for ten more minutes and it's done!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦ What is this smellâ¦â¦?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, finally awake, are you?
Good grief, what a sleepyhead!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, what is this...?
Did you make this on your own without telling me?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Humph! It's already made, so there's nothing we can do about it now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... No, not in the least. I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "If anything, it is splendid! Truly magnificent!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You see, with that medicine, the recipe is flawless,
but its poor reproducibility was the real bottleneck.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The temperature control and all that stuff is super delicate...
To put it simply, mass production is a total pain in the neck!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that really saved me.
I've been working on this for three days and three nights straight,
so I was completely worn out, you see.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So that's why you were asleep? Honestly, you're such a research maniac.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Is this really such a delicate medicine?
It was totally easy to make, though.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Is this really such a delicate medicine?
It was totally easy to make, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I knew she was dexterous,
but to pull it off so effortlessly...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Sweep-kun!
Care to help me make it?
I would love nothing more than to borrow that immense magical power of yours!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Such immense magical power...!
Fufun, well, I suppose I have no choice!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I expect my reward, of course!
Share some of the medicine you made.
Plus the usual tea and sweets! Make 'em super sweet!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, certainly! Alright then,
let's get right to work, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"What's that?! Are you doubting my magic?
Of course it succeeded, duh!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Humph! If you doubt it that much, I'll make you drink it and see for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's a splendid idea!
Now then, bottoms up, my friend!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Heyyy! Waaiiit up!
I'm not letting you get away~!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahahaaaa!!
